entries.title: Job 34:1
segments: And Elihu answered and said,

entries.title: Job 34:2
segments: Hear my words, wise men; and give ear to me, you who have knowledge;

entries.title: Job 34:3
segments: For the ear tries words, [as] the palate tastes food.

entries.title: Job 34:4
segments: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us know among ourselves what [is] good.

entries.title: Job 34:5
segments: For Job has said, I am righteous; and God has taken away my right;

entries.title: Job 34:6
segments: should I lie against my right? My wound cannot be cured; [I am] without rebellion.

entries.title: Job 34:7
segments: What man [is] like Job, [who] drinks up scorning like water;

entries.title: Job 34:8
segments: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

entries.title: Job 34:9
segments: For he has said, It profits a man nothing when he is accepted with God.

entries.title: Job 34:10
segments: Therefore listen to me, O man of heart; far be it from God to commit iniquity; and from the Almighty, to do wrong.

entries.title: Job 34:11
segments: For He repays man's work, and causes him to find according to [his] ways.

entries.title: Job 34:12
segments: Yes, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

entries.title: Job 34:13
segments: Who has given the earth as a deposit with Him? Or who has set the whole world in order?

entries.title: Job 34:14
segments: If He sets His heart on man, [if] He gathers to Himself his spirit and his breath,

entries.title: Job 34:15
segments: all flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again to dust.

entries.title: Job 34:16
segments: If now [you have] understanding, hear this; listen to the sound of my words.

entries.title: Job 34:17
segments: Shall one who hates right govern? And will you condemn Him who is just and mighty?

entries.title: Job 34:18
segments: Who says to a king, O worthless one; and to nobles, O evil one?

entries.title: Job 34:19
segments: [How much less to Him who] does not lift up the face of rulers, nor regard the rich before the poor? For all of them [are] the work of His hands.

entries.title: Job 34:20
segments: In a moment they die, and a people are shaken at midnight and pass away; and the mighty shall be taken away without a hand.

entries.title: Job 34:21
segments: For His eyes [are] on the ways of man, and He sees all his steps.

entries.title: Job 34:22
segments: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death to hide there the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Job 34:23
segments: For He does not still impose on man to go before God in judgment.

entries.title: Job 34:24
segments: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their place.

entries.title: Job 34:25
segments: Therefore He knows their works, and He overturns in the night, so that they are destroyed.

entries.title: Job 34:26
segments: He strikes them for evil deeds in the place of the watchers,

entries.title: Job 34:27
segments: because thus they turned from following Him, and they did not consider all His ways;

entries.title: Job 34:28
segments: [so as] to cause the cry of the poor to come to Him, for He hears the cry of the afflicted.

entries.title: Job 34:29
segments: And He gives quietness, who then can condemn? And when He hides [His] face, who can behold Him? And [it may be] against a nation and a man together;

entries.title: Job 34:30
segments: from the reigning of ungodly men, from [being] snares for the people.

entries.title: Job 34:31
segments: For has any said to God, I have taken away; I will not pervert?

entries.title: Job 34:32
segments: Besides what I see, You teach me; if I have done iniquity, I will do it no more.

entries.title: Job 34:33
segments: Must He repay because you rejected [it]? For you must choose, and not I; therefore speak what you know.

entries.title: Job 34:34
segments: Men of understanding will say to me, and a wise man who hears me [will say],

entries.title: Job 34:35
segments: Job has spoken without knowledge, and his words [were] without wisdom.

entries.title: Job 34:36
segments: Would that Job may be tried to the end because [his] answers [are] like men of iniquity.

entries.title: Job 34:37
segments: For he adds rebellion to his sins; he claps [his] hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.
